name: VisionCone
src_typeComment: Drop on an enemy/guard and it detects Transforms on targetMask within range + field-of-view angle, with a raycast occlusion check against obstacleMask so hiding behind a wall actually works. Genre-agnostic: stealth games use this directly; racing/sports AI can ignore it entirely and just use SteeringBehaviors.

src_serialized.name: eye
src_serialized.tooltip: Where the cone originates — assign an eye/head transform, or leave empty to use this object's position.

src_serialized.name: fieldOfViewAngle
src_serialized.tooltip: Full field-of-view angle in degrees (e.g. 90 = 45 degrees either side of forward).

src_serialized.name: targetMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Layers that count as detectable targets.

src_serialized.name: obstacleMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Layers that block line of sight (walls, etc). A target behind one of these isn't seen even if inside the cone.

src_serialized.name: scanInterval
src_serialized.tooltip: How often (seconds) to re-scan. 0 = every frame.

src_members.name: CanSee
src_members.comment: Public so you can also ad-hoc query "can I see this specific transform right now" outside the regular scan.
